name: Blood for Blood
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.
narrative.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Ayessa looks shaken and distant as you hand her the windstone charms.>Don't mind me, Sladkiy. Today has merely been... a trying day. Thank you for your service to the windshapers thus far.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Al'Aketh have engaged in their bloody zealotry for far too long. This is only the start of the reckoning they face.
